category_summary:
### Executive Signal
- The **agent stack is consolidating** around open orchestration, persistent memory, and BYOK routing — pushing AI from demos into production-grade enterprise infrastructure.

### Priority Developments
- **Agent orchestration is becoming a standard layer**: [google/ax](/?date=2026-09-25&category=github_trending#item-9c59b80fdafa), [stablyai/orca](/?date=2026-09-25&category=github_trending#item-b3a6b26fa3d6), [obra/superpowers](/?date=2026-09-25&category=github_trending#item-f49502979215), and strands-agents/harness-sdk all target production-grade control planes, signaling a new infrastructure category.
- **Learning memory is now a first-class primitive**: [vectorize-io/hindsight](/?date=2026-09-25&category=github_trending#item-cc7155b29697) addresses the long-horizon state problem that blocks enterprise deployment of agents at scale.
- **BYOK and model-agnostic routing are commoditizing model access**: experientiallabs/experiential and [superdesigndev/treg](/?date=2026-09-25&category=github_trending#item-2b5927eb33d5) make cost optimization and lock-in avoidance table stakes for CIOs.
- **Agents are invading core knowledge-worker surfaces**: [dream-num/univer](/?date=2026-09-25&category=github_trending#item-2be98cd199e8) targets spreadsheets, docs, and slides, shifting workflow automation from copilots to autonomous actors.
- **Frontier labs are moving down-stack into regulated verticals**: [anthropics/financial-services](/?date=2026-09-25&category=github_trending#item-9a0f41e62a8b) shows foundation-model vendors directly contesting incumbent SaaS moats in high-value industries.

### Leadership Implications
- **Stand up an agent architecture roadmap** covering orchestration, memory, and BYOK routing within two quarters — vendor selection is now urgent, not exploratory.
- **Audit document-heavy workflows** in finance, legal, and ops for autonomous-agent automation; the open-source tooling curve is compressing first-mover windows rapidly.
